summary: 锂盐转换线的项目状态不是单向从建设走向达产：机械完工或首产后仍可能因原料不足、成本倒挂、品质/认证问题或设备整改退回低负荷、阶段停线、care-and-maintenance，再在价格、矿源或客户条件改善后重启；有效产能因此需要保存可逆状态和每次状态生效时间。
why_search_may_miss_it: 项目数据库通常把first production或commissioning视为不可逆里程碑，后续低负荷、停线和重启可能散落在运营更新中，容易继续被计入永久有效nameplate。

recalled_details.gap_reason: CHC-003 and CHC-016 already cover ramp failure, delay and low utilization, but the compact layer does not explicitly model post-first-product project states as reversible with dated idle/restart transitions
recalled_details.replay_link: would prevent point-in-time supply from treating a once-commissioned converter train as continuously available through 2019-2020 when operating state later reversed

suggested_queries: lithium converter idled train care and maintenance restart first production
锂盐 项目 首产 停线 复产 低负荷 care maintenance
disconfirmation_queries: once a lithium conversion train reaches first production it remains continuously available at an economically meaningful operating rate
